@returns 1 when a file has been read to its end, otherwise 0.

```blitzbasic
;run
file = WriteFile("streams_eof_example.tmp")
WriteLine file, "a"
WriteLine file, "b"
CloseFile file
file = ReadFile("streams_eof_example.tmp")
While Not Eof(file)
	Print ReadLine$(file)
Wend
CloseFile file
DeleteFile "streams_eof_example.tmp"
```

```text
a
b
```
@param stream  The stream to check.
